data.situation:
At eleven, Jo came back with a sign and a length of red tape. The leader had decided to ban skating on the ramp until the loose board had been removed and the area checked. Jo stretched the tape across the entrance. The ramp was now out of bounds, although people could still reach the exercise bars by the garden path. Maya helped attach a small rules card to the fence. It referred to the centre's safety regulations and showed the appropriate place to wait. One child asked whether a different pair of shoes would let him enter. The leader shook her head and pointed towards the waiting bench. Jo placed the final sign where it could be seen before anyone reached the tape. RAMP CLOSED — 22 MAY
Skating is banned here while the loose board is removed and the area checked. The space beyond the red tape is out of bounds. Please use the bench outside the fence while you wait. The exercise bars can be reached from the garden path. The activity leader will update this sign when the ramp reopens.

readingBlocks.zh: 十一点，乔带着一块告示和一卷红色带子回来了。负责人决定禁止在坡道上滑行，直到松动木板移走、场地检查完毕。乔把带子拉过入口。现在坡道禁止进入，不过人们仍能沿花园小路走到锻炼横杆区。玛雅帮忙把一张小规则卡挂在围栏上。卡片提到中心的安全规章，也标明了适合等候的地方。一个孩子问，换一双鞋是不是就能进去。负责人摇摇头，指向等候长椅。乔把最后一块告示放在还没走到红带前就能看见的位置。

readingBlocks.en:
RAMP CLOSED — 22 MAY
Skating is banned here while the loose board is removed and the area checked. The space beyond the red tape is out of bounds. Please use the bench outside the fence while you wait. The exercise bars can be reached from the garden path. The activity leader will update this sign when the ramp reopens.
readingBlocks.zh:
坡道关闭——5月22日
松动木板移除、场地接受检查期间，这里禁止滑行。红带后的区域禁止进入。等候时请使用围栏外的长椅。锻炼横杆区可从花园小路到达。坡道重新开放时，活动负责人会更新这块告示。

glossary.note: ban 是动词，过去式与过去分词为 banned；ban skating 表示禁止滑行，skating is banned 表示滑行被禁止。
glossary.example: The leader decided to ban skating on the ramp.
glossary.exampleZh: 负责人决定禁止在坡道上滑行。

externalEvidence.definition: prohibit especially by legal means or social pressure

glossary.note: out of bounds 描述不允许进入的区域；本句指红带后的坡道区域。
glossary.example: The space beyond the red tape is out of bounds.
glossary.exampleZh: 红带后的区域禁止进入。
